narration:0:1910110001:0.text: 就在你准备继续打听潮汐异常的情报时，一个急切的身影突然冲了过来……
narration:0:1910110001:0.source_cn: 就在你准备继续打听潮汐异常的情报时，一个急切的身影突然...

say:2:1910110002:1.text: Hey! My boat's stuck! Someone give me a hand!
say:2:1910110002:1.source_cn: 喂！我家的木舟卡住了，谁来帮帮忙！

say:3:1910110003:1.text: It's just stranded because the tide pulled back early. Won't it float again when the water comes back?
say:3:1910110003:1.source_cn: 是因为退潮提前了吧。等涨潮不就浮起来了？

say:4:1910110004:1.text: I don't have time to wait! I have to get out there and find that little brat <style="highlight">Tolan</style>!
say:4:1910110004:1.source_cn: 不行，我现在就得出海。我要去找<style=highl...

say:5:1910110005:1.text: Easy, Toba! It's not like your kid running off is anything new.
say:5:1910110005:1.source_cn: 老涛巴，急什么。你家娃子又不是第一次离家出走。

say:6:1910110006:1.text: It's different this time! He's been gone for two whole nights!
say:6:1910110006:1.source_cn: 这次不一样，他已经两个晚上没回来了！

say:8:1910110008:1.text: Amare's searched the whole village! There's no trace of him! That little rascal's always running off to the sea, never listening to a word I say!
say:8:1910110008:1.source_cn: 阿汶贝把整个村全找遍了，哪里都没有。那臭小子有事没事就...

say:9:1910110009:1.text: Just wait til I get my hands on him, he's in for it this time!
say:9:1910110009:1.source_cn: 这次把他抓回来，看我怎么教训他！

say:10:1910110010:1.text: But the sea's too dangerous right now. You should—
say:10:1910110010:1.source_cn: 现在海上太危险了，还是——

say:11:1910110011:1.text: That's exactly why I have to find him! Quick, I need some strong folks to help me!
say:11:1910110011:1.source_cn: 所以我才得赶快把他找回来！快找几个力气大点的帮忙！
